Tabelog: 18:00–22:00, closed Tuesday. Reservations by phone (075-252-2587) or TableCheck (official site). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats: 5 at the counter, tables for 4 and 2 (Tabelog); TableCheck says 9. Private hire possible; non-smoking; sommelier (Tabelog). No printed drink menu — the wines change often and the staff recommend (June 2024). On Fuyacho between Oshikoji and Nijo, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 11 (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_isil_isil_fuyacho.notes: [Italian · Fuyacho, a chef and a sommelier] A glass-fronted room on Fuyacho with a short counter, a sofa corner and a gleaming kitchen, where a female chef cooks alone and a male sommelier pours. Order à la carte — tartare, porcini pasta, risotto, game such as Ezo deer — or take the ¥9,900 chef’s choice, and let the sommelier pick wines by the glass; there is no drink menu. Expect ¥10,000–20,000 a head with wine. Last entry 20:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the restaurant as “run by a lovely couple” (December 2022) and as “the space created by a female chef and a male sommelier” (November 2022). In January 2026: “The dishes prepared by the female chef, who works solo, are all crafted with great care”, with wine service by the male sommelier “on par with famous restaurants in Tokyo”. A July 2025 regular credits “the personalities of the two owners”.
chef_bio.philosophy: Thinking about the outline of each flavour and how it finishes (TableCheck, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte Italian; risotto; game; wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: At the end of a December 2021 dinner, the chef and the sommelier came to the door to see the guests off.
A November 2022 guest, already full, wanted the porcini pasta and the crab risotto too, and the kitchen cut the portions down to fit.
A June 2024 party of three found no drink menu and no explanation of how the shared plates would be priced, and felt it poor value.

kyoto_kamomeken_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. The hayashi sauce is made from additive-free tomato juice and plenty of onion (Tabelog shop text), but nothing is said about flour or roux; most toppings are breaded and fried (katsu, croquettes, shrimp fry, chicken nanban).
kyoto_kamomeken_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the sauce reminds a reviewer of beef stew, with a buttery richness (November 2026); toppings of hamburg steak, sausage, egg, cheese and fried meat or seafood.
kyoto_kamomeken_shijo.hours_raw: 10:00–20:30 daily (L.O. 20:00); irregular closures; closed 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Meal tickets from a machine (May and November 2026). No cards; e-money and QR codes accepted (Tabelog; PayPay, November 2026). 12 seats: a counter and about two tables (Tabelog; November 2026). Non-smoking; take-out and delivery; children welcome, one stroller at a time (Tabelog). Self-service water (May 2026). On Shijo-dori just west of Karasuma, 2–3 min from Hankyu Karasuma and Shijo Stns exit 26 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kamomeken_shijo.notes: [Hayashi rice · Shijo Karasuma, from 10:00] A small ticket-machine counter on Shijo-dori west of Karasuma that serves only hayashi rice: a light, tomato-sharp sauce over 250 g of rice from ¥800, built up with toppings from cheese and egg to katsu, hamburg steak and a taro-and-crab croquette. Quick, cheap and solo-friendly, open 10:00–20:30. Some reviewers want a richer, demi-glace-style sauce. A March 2026 reviewer says it replaced a Hino-ya Curry franchise in the same space.

roles: Operated by 株式会社かもめ (Ukyo-ku, per the NTA invoice registry)
chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer writes that the space used to be a Hino-ya Curry and, since the Instagram account stayed the same, guesses the franchisee simply changed its business. The Tabelog invoice number T1130001057447 is registered to 株式会社かもめ, a company in Ukyo-ku, Kyoto.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 diner spotted a sign calling the taro croquette a hidden specialty and switched from the hamburg steak.
A May 2026 parent and child arrived at opening and watched customers come in one after another.

kyoto_kameya_hironaga.gf_detail: Ask. The warabi mochi is described as made from authentic bracken starch with brown sugar, dusted with kinako of Tanba black soybeans and wasanbon (2023–2026 reviews), but no ingredient list is published; the shop also sells monaka, ohagi, sakura mochi and daifuku, not described.
kyoto_kameya_hironaga.vegan_detail: Ask. The warabi mochi as described is bracken starch, brown sugar, kinako and wasanbon (2023–2026 reviews), but no full ingredient list is published.
kyoto_kameya_hironaga.hours_raw: 9:00–18:00, Wednesday to 17:00, every day (Tabelog); hours may change. A takeaway shop: “a cozy sales area without dining space” (February 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; phone 075-431-4438). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No parking; the street in front is narrow (Tabelog; March 2025). A sample of warabi mochi is offered on entry (February 2025). On Aburanokoji south of Shimochojamachi, near the Kyoto Prefectural Office, about 15 min on foot from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; February 2025).
kyoto_kameya_hironaga.notes: [Wagashi · Aburanokoji, the warabi mochi] A small machiya sweet shop near the Kyoto Prefectural Office, with no seats — you buy and take away. The draw is a soft, melting warabi mochi of real bracken starch and brown sugar under homemade kinako of Tanba black soybeans, ¥1,000 for a small pack that keeps a week; it was featured on Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai. Also monaka, ohagi and seasonal sweets. The owner trained at Kameya Kiyonaga in Gion. Cash only.

roles: Owner (unnamed), trained at Kameya Kiyonaga in Gion
chef_bio.background: A February 2025 review, quoting the shop’s own introduction, says “The owner trained at the famous ‘Kameya Kiyonaga’ shop in Gion before establishing this place.” In December 2023 a reviewer described a shop “operated by an elderly couple” with the couple’s son; in January 2026 another described an elderly gentleman running the shop alone, hands covered in warabi mochi and kinako while packing. A July 2026 regular of four years noted the sweets now come pre-packed, where four years earlier each order was taken from the fridge, cut, weighed and packed on the spot, and that prices had gone up.

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 regular recalled long queues after a television appearance, now calmer.
A February 2025 visitor was offered a sample of warabi mochi on entering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京御菓子司 亀屋博永、和菓子、上京区油小路下長者町下る大黒屋町38、丸太町駅から809m、9:00〜18:00 (水曜は17:00まで)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、駐車場なし、テイクアウト、子ども可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 本わらび粉と黒糖のわらび餅、Tanba 黒豆のきな粉と和三盆、Matsuko no Shiranai Sekai で紹介、小1,000円 (2人前)、大2,000円 (4人前)、常温で1週間、最中、おはぎ、桜餅、水無月、いちご大福、店主は祇園の Kameya Kiyonaga で修業、イートインはない、年配の夫婦と息子の店との声 (2023年)、年配の男性がひとりで営むとの声 (2026年)。

kyoto_angledian_shogoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a range: French-style cakes on sponge, tart and choux bases, roll cakes, pound cake and financiers (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_angledian_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, butter, egg and chocolate cakes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_angledian_shogoin.hours_raw: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday 12:00–18:00; closed Monday, Tuesday and Saturday; days and closing times vary and close early when sold out — check the shop’s Instagram (Tabelog). Takeaway only. Reservations in person at the shop only, not by phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). Photographs of the display case are not allowed without asking (March 2026). Non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog). Directly opposite Kyoto University Hospital, 4 min from the Kyoto University Hospital bus stop, 10 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 April 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_angledian_shogoin.notes: [Patisserie · Shogoin, opposite the university hospital] A small, chic cake shop so understated that people walk past it, across from Kyoto University Hospital. Glossy French-style cakes — the Chestnut, a mosque-shaped Mont Blanc, Écarlate, cream puffs, seasonal tarts — from about ¥900, carefully packed to take away. Open four days a week from noon until sold out; check Instagram. Reviewers call it refined; a few find it heavy or sweet.

chef_bio.background: An October 2025 reviewer writes that the cakes are “crafted by a chef who previously served as the pastry chef at Robuchon”, and that the careful packing reflects the chef’s commitment. Another October 2025 visitor thought “it seems that the owner runs it alone.”
chef_bio.specialty: Entremets and petits gâteaux; chestnut cakes.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular asked to photograph the display, which is normally not allowed, and was kindly let.
A May 2026 first-timer was nervous after reading the shop’s notices but was welcomed warmly.

kyoto_french_oden_yahoyorozu.gf_detail: Ask — the shop asks for allergies in advance. Oden includes fu and mochi pouches, served with French sauces, plus bread and bistro dishes (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_french_oden_yahoyorozu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden simmers in a domestic beef-bone broth and comes with cheese sauces (Tabelog).
kyoto_french_oden_yahoyorozu.hours_raw: Tue–Sat, holidays and days before/after holidays 15:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; tell the shop about allergies in advance; groups of 14 or more get the whole shop (Tabelog). Service charge 10% on à la carte, and a ¥500 charge for drinks only — Tabelog's Japanese original: "アラカルトはサービス料10%、ドリンクのみはチャージ＋５００円". 14 seats: a counter with Kyoto kumiko woodwork and tables upstairs; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). In 三条食彩ろぉじ, the alley off Sakaimachi south of Sanjo; 6 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_french_oden_yahoyorozu.notes: [French oden & wine · Sanjo Shokusai Roji] A bright little bistro in a Sanjo alley that simmers oden in beef-bone broth and serves it with French sauces — try daikon or egg with gorgonzola — alongside wine. Courses from ¥4,400; à la carte +10%. Some find the flavours mild. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; trained in Italian cooking per a November 2024 reviewer)
chef_bio.background: Per a November 2024 reviewer: a new place that opened the year before, whose chef trained in Italian cuisine and pairs oden with Italian-style sauces. Per the operator: a counter with Kyo-kumiko woodwork.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 first-timer found the food beautiful but the flavours "a bit too mild", with little difference between the gorgonzola and mozzarella sauces.
A March 2026 diner who grew up dipping oden in red miso found the Burgundy-style sauce a natural fit.
Arriving late in January 2025, a guest found many dishes sold out and was shown upstairs, where the doorbell was a little bell.

kyoto_maruhiro_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauces, a sukiyaki-style cut and rice; no gluten information (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_maruhiro_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku course of wagyu (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_maruhiro_gion.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 daily incl. Sundays and holidays, later by arrangement; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Bookings needed — usually full with regulars (2024 reviews); harder since a January 2026 TV appearance (February 2026). Omakase course only (October 2024); ¥10,200 in May 2024. Cash only — no cards (Tabelog). 14 seats incl. a counter and a private tatami room for 4; Tabelog lists smoking as allowed (Tabelog). Near Yasaka Shrine, south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; November 2025).
kyoto_maruhiro_gion.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion near Yasaka Shrine] A tiny, regular-filled yakiniku counter where the meat-obsessed owner picks every cut and shows you how to grill it: one omakase course (about ¥10,000–15,000) from chateaubriand to rice. Cash only; book early. Open nightly to 23:00.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the shop alone per the operator; 2024 reviewers met the owner and a spouse
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2013 (Tabelog). Per the operator: "the owner manages everything alone" across 14 seats, pacing dishes to each table. A March 2024 reviewer was told the chef and a spouse had run it for about ten years; a January 2026 reviewer relates that the shop usually refuses media, but agreed to filming of Kotaro Koizumi for Nippon TV's "Oh! My God" (aired in Kanto only).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "The higher the quality of fat, the quicker it melts just from being touched or cut… delivering only what I personally find delicious."

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 reviewer: only a ¥10,200 course is offered at first, and diners who appreciate it may later order higher-grade meat.
During the July 2026 Gion Matsuri, a diner saw the portable shrine pass right in front of the shop.
After seeing the owner on TV, a February 2026 viewer phoned and was surprised to get a booking from the owner himself.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): まる廣、焼肉・居酒屋・鍋、東山区祇園町南側529-1 祇園Kentビル 1F、祇園四条から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (23時以降は相談)、不定休 (日祝も営業)、カード不可、14席、4名の個室、喫煙可、2013年9月1日オープン、肉好きで知られる店主、脂の質や肉のきめを見極め自ら食べて美味しいものだけ、店主一人で切り盛り、常連の6割が頼むおまかせコース。口コミ (2024年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 夫婦で約10年、10,200円のコース、6種の肉、シャトーブリアン、すき焼き風、焼き野菜、トマトのマリネ、ご飯、季節の果物、Nippon TV の「Oh! kyoto_sanshiki_udon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bonito-dashi broth, chicken tempura, meat and curry udon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sanshiki_udon.hours_raw: Mon 11:00–15:00; Wed–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–20:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). No bookings; short waits at lunch (2026 reviews). kyoto_sanshiki_udon.notes: [Udon · Gojo near Kiyomizu-dera] A popular little udon shop on Gojo-dori where a Kagawa-born owner makes chewy Sanuki-style noodles: chicken-tempura bukkake from ¥900, curry udon, and a fragrant bonito broth. Some find the noodles softer than true Sanuki. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), from Kagawa Prefecture per an October 2026 reviewer
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 reviewer: homemade noodles by an owner from Kagawa Prefecture; reviewers call it a popular spot for curry udon (January 2026).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner expected more chewiness and wondered whether the noodles are adjusted for tourists.
A March 2026 guest found too much udon for the broth, so the tempura batter soaked it up.
At the peak of Obon in August 2026 the shop was full, but a table opened within ten minutes and the bowl came in five.

kyoto_eitaroya.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, simmered and fried dishes, Yanagawa nabe and kamameshi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_eitaroya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Japanese izakaya on dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_eitaroya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00 (food last order 22:00); closed Sunday and once a month irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings advised — usually full (2026 reviews). Order the kamameshi early, as it takes time (February 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR (Tabelog). A counter, three tables for four and one for two, and a tatami room; non-smoking (Tabelog; February 2026). On Oike-dori east of Muromachi; 1 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_eitaroya.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike] A busy, always-booked izakaya by Karasuma-Oike station loved for its showpiece sashimi platter and seasonal Kyoto dishes — Fushimi peppers with jako, grilled ayu, eel Yanagawa nabe — finished with kamameshi. About ¥5,000–10,000. Book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a popular, usually fully booked izakaya with friendly regulars, the hall run by one staff member; an October 2026 reviewer says it has been selected as a Bib Gourmand.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner enjoyed the friendly regulars and said "the owner looked just like Keanu Reeves".
A February 2026 walk-in met "some slightly rude comments" and left soon, while granting it suits those who like a chatty izakaya.
A July 2026 party paid ¥4,500 a head for a sashimi platter of salmon and cheaper fish while other tables got tuna for the same price — "very frustrating".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: えいたろう屋、日本料理・居酒屋、中京区御池通室町東入ル龍池町448、烏丸御池駅から徒歩1分、月〜土 17:30〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00)、日曜休み、月1回不定休、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・QR 可、カウンターと座敷、禁煙。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): いつも予約で満席、刺身の盛り合わせ (1人4,500円)、菜の花と蛤の吸い物、鮪の味噌、蓮根まんじゅう、Fushimi とうがらしとちりめんじゃこの炊いたん、えんどう豆の団子、ビワマス、鰹のわさび味噌、子持ち鮎、鴨の唐揚げ、牛蒡と鰻の柳川鍋、釜飯は早めに、ホールは一人、常連が気さく、ビブグルマンとの記述、店主が Keanu Reeves に似ているという声、刺身の内容が他の卓と違ったという苦情。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; a chatty regulars' counter.

kyoto_kakuuchi_bansan.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya plates, tempura, shumai and wheat ramen to finish (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_kakuuchi_bansan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the ramen broth is simmered six hours with seafood dashi, and oden and most plates use dashi or meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kakuuchi_bansan.hours_raw: 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00), daily, with irregular closures announced on Tabelog (e.g. 3, 10, 11 and 18 November) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and often needed; a booking is cancelled if you cannot be reached 10 minutes after the time (Tabelog; October 2026). No children (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 with tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「300円（税込）」). Drinks are self-serve from the fridge — pour your own sake and leave a numbered tag (2026 reviews). 23 seats: standing bar and counter, private rooms for 4–20 (Tabelog). Cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). In the Yuasa Kaikan, a renovated townhouse north of Gojo; 4 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_kakuuchi_bansan.notes: [Sake bar & izakaya · Gojo, pour your own and finish with ramen] A Kyoiro-group bar in a renovated townhouse north of Gojo where you take sake from the fridge, pour it yourself, and order Kyoto snacks — Nanatani duck, dashimaki, garlic tomatoes — before the house "Yamamen" ramen in a six-hour broth. Lively and affordable; book ahead. No children; ¥300 charge. 15:00–24:00.

roles: Shop of the Kyoiro group; staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a shop created by the representative of the Kyoiro group, a Kyoto restaurant group, serving sake from around Japan and Kyoto seasonal dishes in a townhouse, with noodles in a broth simmered six hours. A June 2026 diner noted the same ramen is served at a Gion shop open only from 23:00 to 2:00.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per a May 2026 reviewer quoting the shop: "Noodles after drinking that lead to tomorrow."

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner found the regular ramen too much for one after shumai, but drank all the broth.
A May 2026 diner who came for the noodles found it an izakaya and settled for a light drink.
An August 2026 diner found prices a little above typical standing bars but the flavours exceptional.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・鍋・ラーメン、下京区五条上ル亀屋町172 湯浅会館 1F、五条駅から徒歩4分、毎日15:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、不定休 (11月3・10・11・18日休み)、予約可 (10分連絡がなければキャンセル)、子ども入店不可、チャージ300円 (税込)、23席、個室 4〜20名、カード・交通系IC可、京色グループの代表が手がける店、6時間炊いた清湯と魚介出汁の締めの麺、冷蔵庫から自分で取る全国の地酒。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): Yamamen、万願寺の煮びたし700円、おでん盛り合わせ950円、Nanatani の鴨のたたき、Nanatani の卵のだし巻き、くらげの刺身、ガーリックトマト、馬刺し、4人で1人約6,500円、立ち飲みより少し高めという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Pour your own drinks from the fridge; book ahead; no children; ¥300 charge.

kyoto_gion_shirakawa_ramen.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles, and fried karaage and croquettes on the sets (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shirakawa_ramen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork chashu and a bonito-accented miso broth (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shirakawa_ramen.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:30; closed Monday (Tabelog). A December 2025 reviewer listed Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:00, closed weekends — check before going; the official site posts hour changes. No reservations; buy a ticket at the machine; short waits at busy times (Tabelog; January and May 2026). No cards; e-money and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 13 seats: 9 at the counter and a table for 4 (Tabelog; April 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). At the south end of the Furukawa-cho arcade, near Ipponbashi on the Shirakawa; 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Opened 1 May 2021 (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_gion_shirakawa_ramen.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama, stir-fried miso in an old arcade] A thirteen-seat ramen shop at the far end of the Furukawa-cho arcade near the Shirakawa, known for miso ramen made with stir-fried miso — rich, ginger-bright, with watercress and caramelised chashu — and a lighter shoyu chuka soba from ¥950. Buy a ticket at the machine. No cards. Closed Monday; check hours, which have changed.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a ramen shop of "authentic aori (stir-fried) miso" that opened on 1 May (2021, Tabelog) on the south side of the Furukawa-cho arcade, and has appeared in 究極のラーメン 2020 and 2022 (関西版) and a LEAF guide to Kyoto and Shiga ramen. A January 2026 diner was greeted by the owner during a wait.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner found the extra chashu a bit dry and tough but the karaage good, and most guests were tourists from abroad.
A May 2026 diner found the shoyu ramen smooth but would have liked more dashi or soy punch.
An April 2025 diner touring with friends from abroad was struck by the warm welcome while waiting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-shirakawa.com): 東山区古川町商店街南側の「本格煽り味噌」のラーメン店、5月1日開店、雑誌「究極のラーメン2020 関西版」「究極のラーメン2022 関西版」、LEAF 別冊「京都 滋賀旨いラーメン」に掲載、営業時間変更のお知らせあり。食べログ: ラーメン、東山区稲荷町北組567-26、東山駅から徒歩5分、火〜日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:30、月曜休み、予約不可、カード不可、電子マネー・楽天ペイ可、13席、禁煙、2021年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): 味噌ラーメン、辛味噌、中華そば950円、チャーシュー追加300円、C セット (ご飯と唐揚げ) +400円、昼のセット1,200円、食券制、海外の客が多い、チャーシューが硬いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Buy a ticket at the machine; no cards (e-money and Rakuten Pay); check hours.

kyoto_ortensia_marutamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Courses centre on pasta, gratins and fried seafood (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_ortensia_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood-led Italian with cheese and house-cured pork (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_ortensia_marutamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 and dinner 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; lunch is cash only (Tabelog). Lunch course about ¥5,300 with a drink (December 2025); chef’s dinner course of 5–6 dishes with a drink ¥8,300 (May 2026); à la carte also offered (January 2026). 14 seats; private hire; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX) at dinner (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Marutamachi; 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened October 2019 per Tabelog (a review says November 2019).
kyoto_ortensia_marutamachi.notes: [Italian · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, seafood and pasta in a small room] A stylish fourteen-seat Italian north of Marutamachi where chef Takayuki Nasu cooks generous seasonal plates — sea urchin cold pasta, hamo in prosciutto, acqua pazza, house-cured ham. Lunch courses about ¥5,300 (cash only), dinner ¥8,300 with a drink. Reviews mention a Michelin Bib Gourmand (2021–23). Service can be slow when one person runs lunch. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef (named in a May 2025 Tabelog review)
chef_bio.background: A May 2025 Tabelog review names the chef as Takayuki Nasu; a March 2023 review notes a Michelin Bib Gourmand for 2021–2023 and an opening in November 2019 (Tabelog gives 1 October 2019). Reviewers saw one person running lunch alone (December 2025, September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 birthday-lunch diner found two rich appetizers in a row and the flavours strong throughout — better suited to an evening with wine.
A January 2026 diner’s only gripe was that espresso was the only post-meal drink.
A July 2026 regular found the sweet shrimp and buffalo mozzarella sold out but loved the sea-urchin cold pasta.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・海鮮、上京区河原町丸太町上ル出水町274、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約5分、昼 12:00〜15:00・夜 18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約可、昼は現金のみ、14席、貸切可、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX)、2019年10月1日オープン。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年9月、英語): シェフ Takayuki Nasu、ミシュランのビブグルマン 2021〜2023、昼のコース5,300円、夜のおまかせ8,300円 (1ドリンク付き)、雲丹の冷製パスタ、鱧の生ハム巻き、アクアパッツァ、自家製のハムとソーセージ、昼は一人で回していて時間がかかるという声、味が全体に濃いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course; cash only at lunch; JCB or AMEX at dinner.

kyoto_kosa_ace_hotel.gf_detail: Ask — the restaurant asks guests with allergies or dietary restrictions to tell it in advance (Tabelog). Breakfast toasts, focaccia, burgers and set meals with rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kosa_ace_hotel.vegan_detail: Ask in advance (Tabelog). A vegetable set meal, a vegetable clay-pot steam and a salad lunch of over ten vegetables are on the menu, but most dishes have meat, fish or dairy (Tabelog; April–October 2026).
kyoto_kosa_ace_hotel.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 7:00–11:00 (last order 10:30), lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seat requests may not be met; tell the restaurant of allergies or dietary restrictions in advance (Tabelog). Menu prices include a 10% service charge and tax (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％（メニューはサービス料・税込での金額を表示しております。）」). Water: filtered or bottled; one diner found the water charged and expensive (March–April 2026). 118 seats with a bar counter, private room ¥22,000 for 2–12, and a garden terrace (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Third floor of Ace Hotel Kyoto in the Shinpukan; 1 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (Tabelog; official site). Opened 10 August 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kosa_ace_hotel.notes: [Hotel restaurant · Karasuma Oike, farm-to-table in the Ace Hotel] The third-floor restaurant of Ace Hotel Kyoto, a big, sunlit room opening onto a garden terrace. Breakfast from 7:00 (eggs Benedict, avocado toast), one-plate fish or vegetable teishoku and a ten-vegetable salad lunch at about ¥3,000–3,800, and steak courses at night. Prices include service but run high, and water isn't free. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "Kōsa: Seasonal Farm-to-Table Dining in the heart of Kyoto", overlooking a rooftop garden, on the third floor of Ace Hotel Kyoto. Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): valuing farm-to-table and fresh ingredients; opened 10 August 2023. An April 2026 diner had expected an American chef’s steak-and-burger menu.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): serving dishes of fresh ingredients, valuing farm-to-table.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner enjoyed the teishoku and kamameshi but found the water charged and quite expensive.
A May 2026 business diner found the steak course’s five sauces too many and the rice portion small.
An October 2026 breakfast guest who could not eat smoked salmon was given bacon instead.
A June 2026 breakfast guest found the eggs Benedict perfect but the side vegetables a little wilted.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kosakyoto.com): Kōsa、京都の中心の季節のファーム・トゥ・テーブル、屋上庭園を望む、エースホテル京都3F、車屋町245-2。食べログ: 創作料理・オーガニック・カフェ、中京区車屋町245-2 新風館 エースホテル京都 3F、烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩1分、毎日 朝 7:00〜11:00 (L.O. 10:30)・昼 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・夜 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、予約可、アレルギーや食事制限は事前に、サービス料10% (メニューはサービス料・税込で表示)、118席、個室料22,000円、カード可、2023年8月10日オープン、KOSA サラダランチ3,000円 (1ドリンク付き3,800円)。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 朝食6種、エッグベネディクト、魚や野菜の定食と釜飯、和牛バーガー3,800円、ステーキのコース8,000円、庭のテラス、水が有料で高いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; prices include 10% service; give allergies in advance.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Guests with food allergies or dietary restrictions are asked to tell the restaurant in advance; a breakfast guest’s smoked salmon was swapped for bacon on request (October 2026).

kyoto_shunkashuto_zakoya.gf_detail: Ask. Fish-focused courses with dashi, soy-based dishes, fried anglerfish and takikomi rice; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunkashuto_zakoya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish courses — sashimi, grilled fish, eel, sweetfish — with dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunkashuto_zakoya.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–23:00, last dinner seating 21:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservation only, by the day before; fixed start times (Tabelog; September 2026). Two fish-focused courses, ¥6,500 and ¥8,800, at lunch and dinner (March–June 2026). 10 seats at a U-shaped counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; March 2026). Cards (Tabelog). Second floor of ミックナカムラ on Higashinotoin south of Sanjo; 4 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (exit 5 is easiest) (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_shunkashuto_zakoya.notes: [Fish counter · Higashinotoin Sanjo, a couple's omakase] A ten-seat U-shaped counter near Karasuma Oike where a couple serve fish-focused omakase courses of about ten dishes for ¥6,500 or ¥8,800, lunch or dinner: crisp-scaled grilled gurnard, eel, sweetfish, blue-cheese chawanmushi, a seasonal rice whose leftovers come back as onigiri, and a yatsuhashi sorbet. Taste the sake before you order. Book by the day before. Closed Sunday.

roles: A couple (unnamed), per a March 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe "the lovely couple who runs the place" (March 2026), the owner's meticulous craftsmanship and sincere service (March 2026), a manager who explains each dish (March 2026), and staff who explain the sake breweries and styles (June 2026). An August 2025 review of 鮨ざこや places it in the Zakoya group with 鮨ざこや and Petit Poisson.
chef_bio.specialty: Fish omakase; grilled fish with crisp scales.

anecdotes.text: "I appreciated the service of being able to taste the Japanese sake before ordering it, which was a nice touch." — March 2026.
A June 2026 birthday diner, too full for the last rice, had it made into onigiri to take home.
"It would be nice to have a few more options for white wine." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・魚介料理、中京区東洞院三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカムラ2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、月〜土 11:30〜14:00・17:30〜23:00 (夜は21時が最終入店)、日曜休み、完全予約制 (前日まで)、10席 (カウンター)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 魚中心の2つのコース6,500円・8,800円、昼も夜も、コの字のカウンター、夫婦で営む (2026年3月)、日本酒は試飲してから選べる、豆腐のムース、鮎の山椒煮、エスカルゴのバター、ぶりのお造り、ブルーチーズの茶碗蒸し、鰻の焼き物、松茸のお吸い物、秋鮭のご飯、八ツ橋のシャーベット、ほうぼうの鱗焼き、さんまと伏見とうがらしのご飯、あんこうの唐揚げ、残ったご飯はおにぎりに、白ワインの種類がもう少しあればとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by the day before; set courses; sake tastings offered; cards accepted.

kyoto_sushi_zakoya.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae nigiri and small dishes with soy sauce, nikiri and kombu curing; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_zakoya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter of fish, shellfish and sea urchin (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_zakoya.hours_raw: Reservation only; irregular closures; no hours published (Tabelog); dinner usually from 18:00 (August 2026). Referral- or membership-based: Tabelog lists no phone number, and reviewers describe "a referral-only basis" (August 2025), "By Invitation Only" (February 2026) and "reservation-only and membership-based" (April 2025). A 15-piece nigiri course (April 2026); bills about ¥8,000–15,000 (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). 5 counter seats and a private room for about five; private hire for up to six; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) (Tabelog). Dress code: very light clothing is not appropriate (Tabelog). An unmarked room in ミックナカムラ (2F) on Higashinotoin south of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; February 2026).
kyoto_sushi_zakoya.notes: [Sushi · Higashinotoin Sanjo, five seats by referral] A hidden five-seat Edomae counter (and a small private room) of the Zakoya group, behind an unmarked door: a Tokyo-trained chef serves about fifteen pieces of aged-fish nigiri — kombu-cured sea bream, kohada, sea urchin on squid — with good-value sake, for roughly ¥8,000–15,000. It works by referral: no phone number is published, and reviewers came by introduction or membership. Smart dress.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a chef who honed the craft in Tokyo (March 2026), a counter of five with a private room, and a shop of the Zakoya group, which also runs 春夏秋冬ざこや and Petit Poisson (August 2025; February 2026); access is by referral or membership, with no public phone number (2025–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner placed it amid Kyoto's "sushi bubble" of ¥30,000–50,000 omakase as a referral-only counter known for reasonable prices and high satisfaction.
An August 2026 regular's group booked the whole counter on a Sunday, when it usually closes; everyone talked in Chinese and the chef joined in easily.
"A sushi restaurant that feels like a 'secret club,' yet serves absolutely wonderful sushi without any hint of mystery!" — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区東洞院三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカムラ2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、不定休、完全予約制、電話番号の掲載なし、5席、個室あり、貸切可、禁煙、カード可、ドレスコード (極端な軽装は不可)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): ざこやグループ (春夏秋冬ざこや、プチポワソン)、紹介制・会員制、東京で修業した料理人、握り15貫ほどのコース、熟成した魚、鱧の焼霜、Akashi の鯛、ばい貝、いさき、柚子のこはだ、海老の海苔巻き、やりいかとうに、さわら、昆布締めの鯛、赤貝、さんま、しまあじ、うにを塩で、Saku「Kami no Ho」、Dassai、桃のリキュール。

kyoto_ippin_ryori_takakura.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte Japanese dishes including tempura, fried dishes with wheat gluten, agedashi, nanban-zuke and tonkatsu chazuke; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippin_ryori_takakura.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable dishes such as agedashi eggplant, fried bamboo shoots, sesame tofu and nanban-zuke appear, but dashi and fish run through most of the menu (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippin_ryori_takakura.hours_raw: Tuesday to Friday 17:30–22:00; closed Saturday, Sunday and Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations open on the same date one month ahead (the next day if that is a closing day); no bookings for three or more (Tabelog). Fully booked most nights — call at 16:30 a month ahead (February 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 9 counter seats and 2 tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa-dori west of Kawaramachi; 5 min walk from the Kawaramachi Marutamachi bus stop or Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_ippin_ryori_takakura.notes: [À la carte counter · Ebisugawa Kawaramachi, kaiseki taste at izakaya prices] A small family-run counter near City Hall where the day's dishes hang on paper strips and come down once sold out: shirako ponzu, yuba sashimi, fried bamboo shoots, agedashi eggplant, eel tempura, a celebrated sesame tofu and tonkatsu chazuke, mostly around ¥1,000. Regulars call it kaiseki-level at izakaya prices, so it is booked out: reservations open a month ahead, two people max. Cash only. Open Tuesday to Friday.

chef_bio.background: A February 2025 reviewer: "The counter is run by a family, and it seems to be popular among the locals." Reviewers describe a menu that changes with the seasons and the chef's choices, dishes on paper strips removed once sold out, and long-standing regulars (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal à la carte; sesame tofu; tonkatsu chazuke.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor came with a son to the restaurant the parents had visited every year.
"The taste is at the level of a kaiseki restaurant, but the prices are those of an izakaya." — February 2026.
An April 2026 regular of eight years was thrilled the fresh-yuba rice was back — though missed the old version served with wasabi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区夷川通河原町西入西革堂町205 1F、河原町丸太町バス停から徒歩5分、火〜金 17:30〜22:00、土・日・月休み、予約は前月の同日から (定休日なら翌日)、3名以上の予約不可、現金のみ、カウンター9席とテーブル2卓、禁煙。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年7月、英語): 家族で営むカウンター、品書きは短冊でカウンターの上に、売り切れると外す、和食に少しイタリアンも、ワインはなし、鯛の白子ポン酢1,000円、湯葉のお造りと菜の花とわかめの柚子胡椒850円、甘海老と鯛のお造り、鮎の唐揚げ、舞茸と麩の揚げ物、牛しゃぶ、筍の唐揚げ、揚げ出し茄子、生湯葉ご飯、野菜の南蛮漬け、アボカドと長芋のふき味噌、鰻の天ぷら、胡麻豆腐、とんかつ茶漬け、懐石の味で居酒屋の値段、予約が取りにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu on hand-written paper strips; book by phone a month ahead, two people max; cash only.

kyoto_kemuri_smoked.gf_detail: Ask. Smoked dishes including fried gyoza, pizza, nama-fu, hanpen with crab-miso sauce and ochazuke; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kemuri_smoked.vegan_detail: Ask. Smoked yuba, nama-fu, takuan and salad appear, but bacon, cheese, sashimi, chicken and fish cake run through the menu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kemuri_smoked.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day calls often work (July and September 2026). Orders by QR code (July, September 2026). 34 seats incl. counter, semi-private L-shaped seats on two floors and sunken-kotatsu private rooms for 2–4; private hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). A renovated machiya on Ayanokoji west of Muromachi; 3 min walk from Karasuma Stn (Hankyu) (Tabelog).
kyoto_kemuri_smoked.notes: [Smoked izakaya · Ayanokoji Muromachi, everything over hickory] A renovated machiya near Shijo Karasuma devoted to house-smoked food: a smoked appetiser platter, smoked nama-fu and yuba, hanpen with crab-miso sauce, smoked sashimi and takuan, even smoked hojicha and ochazuke — with a closing kamado rice and good-value malts (Laphroaig, Yamazaki 12 at ¥1,200). Counter, semi-private seats and kotatsu rooms. QR ordering. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a modern space in a renovated machiya specialising in homemade smoked dishes over mild hickory chips, from bacon and cheese to nama-fu, yuba and fried gyoza, with kamado rice of Kyohoku aigamo rice and a list of sake, wine and whisky. Reviewers in 2026 praise attentive staff and note QR-code ordering.
chef_bio.philosophy: Smoking for the aroma, not just preservation (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked appetiser platter; smoked nama-fu; kamado rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor, escaping the Gion Matsuri crowds with a last-minute booking, found the machiya a calm place to rest.
"The takuan has a flavor reminiscent of iburigakko, and smoking the sashimi changes its profile" — October 2026, from a whisky lover pleased by the ¥1,200 malts.
"Ordering is done via QR code, which can be a bit cumbersome, but the food is served promptly." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理・ダイニングバー、下京区綾小路通室町西入善長寺町128、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、予約可、34席、掘りごたつの個室 (2〜4名)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード (JCB、AMEX)・PayPay 可、町家を改装したモダンな空間、マイルドなヒッコリーチップの自家製燻製 (ベーコン、チーズ、生麩、湯葉、揚げ餃子)、Kyohoku の合鴨米の釜炊きご飯 (鮭ときのこのバター醤油など)、日本酒・ワイン・ウイスキー。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 燻製の前菜盛り合わせ、燻製はんぺんの蟹味噌ソース焼き、燻製の刺身、燻製たくあん、燻製茶漬け、燻製ほうじ茶、えいひれ、ピザ、焼き鳥、Laphroaig や Yamazaki 12年が1,200円、注文は QR コード、スタッフの対応が良い、祇園祭の日に当日予約。

kyoto_ishiyaki_jidori_torikura.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken grilled on stone with three seasonings, plus kara-age, spring rolls, carbonara and tsukune; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ishiyaki_jidori_torikura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken specialist, with chicken sashimi and seafood (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ishiyaki_jidori_torikura.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30) (Tabelog). Bookings taken; it fills early in the evening (2026 reviews). Tabelog’s Japanese original for service charge reads 「記載なし」 (none stated). 11 seats per Tabelog, at a counter and tatami or sunken-floor tables, with private rooms for 2 and 4 and private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 1st floor of the WISTERIA Building on Nishikikoji east of Karasuma, one block north of Shijo-Karasuma, 155 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_ishiyaki_jidori_torikura.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo-Karasuma, grill-it-yourself jidori on hot stone] A chicken izakaya just north of Shijo-Karasuma where cuts of fresh jidori from Nishiki Market arrive raw with a hot stone for grilling at the table: the seven-cut platter is the way to compare. Chicken sashimi and tataki, tulip kara-age and a rich carbonara to finish round it out, with a deep sake list. Courses about ¥5,000. Open to midnight every day; book for early evening.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: chicken delivered directly from Nishiki Market, grilled slowly on a special stone with a strong far-infrared effect; over 200 drinks and more than 30 sakes; limited Kagoshima chicken sashimi and Nagoya Cochin liver and heart sashimi. The operator is not stated.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner hoping for the liver sashimi found it unavailable that night and had thigh sashimi instead.
A September 2026 guest sent back a beer that was not cold enough, and it was exchanged.
An October 2026 visitor enjoyed grilling yakitori at the table and found the owner and staff friendly, with thorough explanations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 石焼地鶏とりくら、焼き鳥・居酒屋、中京区錦小路烏丸東入ル元法然寺町685 WISTERIAビル1F、烏丸駅から155m、17:00〜24:00 (料理L.O. 23:00、ドリンクL.O. 23:30)、サービス料は記載なし、11席、2名・4名の個室、20名まで貸切可、座敷・掘りごたつ、禁煙、子供可、カード可。公式紹介: 錦市場から直送の新鮮な鶏を、遠赤外線効果の高い特製の石でじっくり焼く、200種以上のドリンク、30種以上の日本酒 (新政など)、数量限定の鹿児島の鶏刺し、名古屋コーチンのレバー・ハツ刺し。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 7種の石焼盛り合わせ、自分で焼く、チューリップの唐揚げ、締めのカルボナーラ、5,000円のコース、飲み放題付きのコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the cuts and the stone grill.

kyoto_severance_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Yoshoku with demi-glace, cream croquettes, kataifi-wrapped fried shrimp, katsu sandwiches and bread; no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_severance_sanjo.vegan_detail: Ask. A meat- and seafood-led yoshoku menu with a few salads; nothing vegan is marked (official site).
kyoto_severance_sanjo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order food 14:00, drinks 14:30); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday and every other Tuesday — see the official Instagram for the calendar (official site; Tabelog). Lunch bookings by phone or Instagram DM (official site). Service charge 5% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「サービス料5%」). 14 seats: a 5-seat counter facing the teppan and 9 table seats; private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and d Barai (official site; Tabelog). A small house on Sanjo-dori east of the Sanjo bridge, 1 min (110 m) from Sanjo Keihan Stn (official site). Opened 6 January 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_severance_sanjo.notes: [Yoshoku · Sanjo bridge, grown-up kids' lunch plates] A small blue-toned house just over the Sanjo bridge where a chef from old-school yoshoku and hotel French kitchens cooks in front of a teppan. Lunch is the famous "adult's kids' lunch": pick three or four of hamburg, kataifi-wrapped giant fried shrimp, crab cream croquette, roast wagyu or fried hamo on one plate (¥3,800–5,000). Dinner is à la carte or courses, with wines chosen by the owner-sommelier; half portions on request. 5% service. Closed Monday and alternate Tuesdays.

roles: Chef; the owner is a sommelier (not named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: trained at long-established yoshoku restaurants and in hotel French kitchens; after going independent ran ROKUMEI, a pop-up curry shop known for European-style curry and grown-up kids’-plate lunches; cooked at Dining Bar MO-JI in Gion for a year, then became chef at its sister restaurant Severance. Severance ran a five-day pop-up at 404Kitchen in Shibuya Sakura Stage on 8–12 May 2025 (official news). Opened 6 January 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: the name means a dividing line — "beyond the door, a blissful space and food apart from everyday life"; old-style yoshoku such as hamburg and steak, updated for today.
chef_bio.specialty: "Angel" fried shrimp wrapped in kataifi; the adult’s kids’ lunch plate.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular reported that the chef brought back the adult’s kids’ lunch after a break because people kept asking for it, now with Manyo beef in the hamburg.
At an August 2026 à la carte dinner the staff offered half portions, since servings are large.
An August 2026 diner liked the homely mood but found the banter among staff too loud.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (severance-kyoto.com): 京都三条鴨川近くの隠れ家洋食レストラン、三条通に面した小さな一軒家、青を基調とした店内、カウンター前に鉄板、最大14名、クラシックとモダンが重なった洋食、ドリンクはオーナーソムリエが厳選、系列店 Dining Bar MO-JI (祇園)。シェフ 小石修平: 老舗洋食店やホテルのフレンチで修業、独立後に間借りカレー店 ROKUMEI、欧風カレーや大人のお子様プレート、MO-JI で1年料理を担当したのち Severance のシェフ。ランチ: 大人のお子様ランチ、Severance プレート5,000円 (4種)、Casual プレート3,800円 (3種)、予約は電話か Instagram の DM。ディナーのアラカルト: 和牛ローストビーフの手毬寿司3,000円、サーモンレアフライ2,420円、Chef’s サラダ2,200円、天使のエビフライ3,800円、とろっとチーズのオムレツ1,430円、和牛の赤身ステーキ5,000円。コース: Standard 10,000円、Special 17,250円。東山区三条大橋東2丁目82、京阪三条から徒歩1分、ランチ火〜日11:30〜15:00、ディナー18:00〜22:00、月曜・隔週火曜定休、14席、カード可。2025年5月8〜12日に渋谷サクラステージ「404Kitchen」に出店。食べログ: 洋食・ビストロ、サービス料5%、d払い可、2023年1月6日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: Lunch bookings by phone or Instagram DM.

kyoto_sakana_ryori_agiyao.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal fish served as sashimi with soy, grilled, simmered, fried and in miso dishes; no gluten information is published (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakana_ryori_agiyao.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish specialist (official site).
kyoto_sakana_ryori_agiyao.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–24:00 per Tabelog; the official site gives lunch from 12:00 and dinner 17:00–23:00. Closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online (official site); late bookings such as 21:00 are taken (October 2026). À la carte carries a seat charge of ¥5,500 including two or three of the day’s recommended dishes (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 「【アラカルトの場合】席料として5500円（税込）（その日のオススメ2〜3皿含み）」); courses also offered; the à la carte menu shows no prices (November 2025). 10 counter seats (official site; a February 2026 reviewer counted 8); private hire for up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor above バル agiyao on Higashinotoin north of Gojo; the entrance is a separate door beside the bar, and bar staff point the way (official site; February and October 2026). Opened 10 December 2007 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakana_ryori_agiyao.notes: [Seafood · Gojo, a ten-seat fish counter] A wood-scented counter upstairs from the white-wine bar バル agiyao, devoted to seasonal fish: choose sashimi, grilled, simmered and fried dishes one by one, or leave it to the chef, with a deep sake list and wine from downstairs. À la carte has a ¥5,500 seat charge that covers two or three dishes of the day; dinners run ¥15,000–20,000. Use the separate door beside the bar. Open late; closed irregularly.

roles: Head chef not named (changed in late 2025, per reviews); operator 株式会社ＦＯＩＳ (invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a fish specialist with only ten counter seats, a calm grown-up izakaya away from the bustle, cooking the owner’s seasonal seafood and Kyoto vegetables and supporting Kyoto food culture with Kyoto-grown ingredients; sake chosen by a kikizakeshi, white wine from バル agiyao on the 1st floor (a separate record). Reviewers in December 2025 and July 2026 note a new head chef. The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ＦＯＩＳ. Opened 10 December 2007 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a time that changes what you think "good fish" is.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi and charcoal-grilled fish, à la carte.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest arriving late from a delayed Shinkansen was met outside by staff and shown through the right door.
A February 2026 diner unsure which door to use was guided upstairs by the bar staff.
A November 2025 diner found the ¥1,000 appetizers arrived only after three dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sakana-agiyao.jp): 魚料理 あぎやお、京都 五条、大人のための居酒屋、カウンター10席のみの魚料理専門店、店主が仕入れる旬の魚介と季節の京野菜、一皿ずつアラカルトでも料理長のおまかせでも、唎酒師が厳選した日本酒を常時20種類以上、1階バル agiyao の白ワインもグラスで、京都産の食材で京都の食文化と地元産業を応援、下京区東洞院五条上る深草町592-3 2階、ランチ12:00〜、ディナー17:00〜23:00、不定休。食べログ: 魚介料理・日本料理・居酒屋、17:00〜24:00、アラカルトは席料5,500円 (その日のオススメ2〜3皿含む)、カウンター10席、20名まで貸切可、禁煙、カード可、2007年12月10日オープン、インボイス T1130001073080 (株式会社ＦＯＩＳ)。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 料理長が交代、値段のないメニュー、こっぺ蟹、ぐじの炭火焼き、岩牡蠣、入口は1階のバルの隣。

cultural_comfort.note: The menu shows no prices; ask as you order.

kyoto_gion_sushi_yoshida.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo dishes and Edomae sushi with soy, plus tempura and fried dishes; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_gion_sushi_yoshida.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kappo and Edomae sushi built on seafood (official site).
kyoto_gion_sushi_yoshida.hours_raw: Dinner 17:30–21:00, bookings only (official site); Tabelog also lists lunch 11:30–13:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Bookings by phone or LINE (official site). Access: reviewers in June 2025, January 2026 and June 2026 describe it as introduction-only (一見さんお断り) and hard to book; the official site invites enquiries. No service charge listed (Tabelog). 10 seats: an 8-seat counter, a raised area for 2 and an upstairs private room for 4; non-smoking; cards, no e-money (Tabelog; official site). In a lane off Hanamikoji in south Gion, 394 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 November 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sushi_yoshida.notes: [Sushi · Gion, kappo and Edomae sushi as you like it] A ten-seat Gion counter off Hanamikoji where the motto is "what you like, how you like, as much as you like": kappo dishes such as hamo, fugu or turtle hot pot first, then Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice, ordered piece by piece or as a course (from ¥25,000; most spend ¥30,000–50,000). Several reviewers describe it as introduction-only and hard to book; the official site takes enquiries by phone or LINE. Dinner, bookings only.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, signed by the owner 吉田紀彦: kappo and Edomae sushi served in peak condition, with care over the number of dishes, temperature and ageing, matched to each guest’s taste; à la carte, omakase courses or dishes to a budget; a raised area and an upstairs private room for business use. Opened November 2014 in Hanamikoji (Tabelog official introduction).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 「お好きなものを お好きな様に お好きなだけ」 — what you like, how you like, as much as you like; a food utopia where truly good things can be enjoyed freely.
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae nigiri on red-vinegar rice after à la carte kappo dishes.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner, there by a friend’s introduction, found the chef gentle-mannered and happy to adjust portions to taste.
A June 2025 guest watched the futomaki being cut to a chosen size.
A September 2026 diner returning after seven years ate eight dishes and then 15 pieces of sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gion-yoshida.com): 祇園 鮨よし田、「お好きなものを お好きな様に お好きなだけ」、品数・温度管理・熟成にこだわり割烹と江戸前鮨を最高の状態で、アラカルト・おまかせコース・ご予算に合わせた料理、小上がりと二階個室、店主 吉田紀彦。ディナー17:30〜21:00 (予約のみ)、料理8品・にぎり10貫・赤だし25,000円〜、お好み割烹とにぎり30,000円〜、東山区祇園町南側570-179、予約は電話か LINE。食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、2014年11月花見小路に開店、赤酢のシャリの江戸前鮨、昼11:30〜13:30・夜17:30〜21:00、不定休、10席 (カウンター8、小上がり2、個室4)、カード可。口コミ: 一見さんお断り (2025年6月、2026年1月・6月)、大将は物腰が柔らかく量も調整、基本はアラカルト。

cultural_comfort.note: Reported as introduction-only; bookings by phone or LINE in Japanese.

existence.note: Official site (copyright 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kushibun_shijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every skewer is battered and fried; nama-fu (wheat gluten) is on the menu; dipping sauces include a sauce and ponzu (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kushibun_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: vegetable skewers (Manganji pepper, lotus root, yuba, konnyaku, pumpkin) share the fryer and batter with meat and seafood; batter ingredients not stated (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kushibun_shijo.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; GoToEat online bookings must order at least ¥2,000 a head (Tabelog). ¥300 cover per person including free cabbage; ¥2,000 a head for a same-day no-show (official site). Cards (VISA, Master) per Tabelog; the official site adds PayPay and Alipay. 17 seats: 6 at the counter, 11 on tatami (official site; Tabelog says 18). Private hire for 15–18. Non-smoking, smoking area (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). Second floor of the Takenaka Building on Shijo-dori, up a staircase; 2–3 min from Hankyu Karasuma exit 26 and subway Shijo exit 2 (official site).
kyoto_kushibun_shijo.notes: [Kushikatsu · Shijo Karasuma, since 1972] A small second-floor counter and tatami room on Shijo-dori, founded in Arashiyama in 1972 and here since 2009. Light, finely battered skewers with Kyoto touches — Manganji pepper, yuba, nama-fu, shiso-wrapped sweetfish — fried to order and handed straight to your plate, with free cabbage. Take the ¥3,280 Arashiyama set or the omakase until you say stop; single skewers from ¥120. ¥300 cover.

chef_bio.background: The official site dates the shop to 1972 in Arashiyama; it closed in 2006 and reopened near Karasuma Station in 2009. An August 2025 reviewer, back after more than ten years, read that actors Shun Oguri and Osamu Mukai had visited. A July 2025 diner was thanked by the owner for eating so many skewers.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 visitor ordered the Manganji pepper skewer about three times.
An August 2025 family on the omakase said the children were thrilled to eat skewers straight out of the fryer.
A February 2025 diner found the oil not well drained and the ochazuke flavourless.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 串かつ専門 串文、下京区四条通新町東入ル月鉾町46 竹中ビル2階 (階段)、阪急烏丸駅26番出口・地下鉄四条駅2番出口から徒歩約3分、17:30〜23:00、不定休、カウンター6席・座敷11席、貸切15〜18名、お通し300円 (キャベツ付き)、当日無断キャンセル2,000円、カード・PayPay・Alipay可、1972年に嵐山で創業、2006年に一度閉店、2009年に烏丸駅近くで再開、おまかせはストップと言うまで。食べログ: 串揚げ・居酒屋、毎日17:30〜23:00、不定休、予約可、18席、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、子ども可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 6種の植物油、細かい衣、京野菜、万願寺とうがらし、湯葉、生麩、京の彩りセット「嵐山」3,280円、1本120〜250円。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter dining with skewers served one by one; ¥300 cover; omakase until you say stop.

kyoto_le_bouchon_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Lyonnais bistro — grilled hanging tender with fries, braised beef, fish of the day, terrines, cassoulet, gratinée lyonnaise (onion soup with bread and cheese), baguette with every lunch; no gluten information (official menus; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_bouchon_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the menus are built on meat, charcuterie and fish; no vegan dish is listed (official menus; Tabelog).
kyoto_le_bouchon_teramachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last entry), dinner 17:30–21:30; closed Thursdays and the second and fourth Mondays (official site; Tabelog gives Thursday only). Monthly opening calendars on the official site. Reservations by phone only, up to a month ahead, on 075-211-5220 between 9:00–11:00, 15:30–17:00 or 21:00–22:00 (official site; Tabelog). Fills by noon on weekdays and holidays; booking advised (2026 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; November 2026). 32 seats, open terrace, non-smoking, English menu, children welcome (Tabelog). On Teramachi just south of Nijo, 4 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_bouchon_teramachi.notes: [Lyonnais bistro · Teramachi-Nijo, cash only] A Parisian-looking bistro with a terrace on Teramachi below Nijo, from the Bellecour group (since 1985). Lunch is the draw: ¥2,100 for salad, free baguette and a main — the grilled hanging tender with fries is the favourite — or ¥2,600 with dessert. At night, Lyonnais classics: gratinée, tripe, cochonnaille, cassoulet. Phone bookings only, at set hours; cash only; fills by noon.

roles: Kitchen (unnamed); operated by the Bellecour group
chef_bio.background: The Bellecour group page (“ベルクールグループ depuis 1985”) lists the salon de thé restaurant オ・タン・ペルデュ and ブション, “伝統的地方料理、リヨン料理” (traditional regional, Lyonnais cooking). No chef is named on the pages opened.
chef_bio.specialty: Lyonnais bistro cooking; grilled hanging tender (onglet).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back for the hanging tender before seeing Super Kabuki at Minami-za.
A family celebrated a mother’s 80th birthday over the meat dishes and the praline dessert (September 2026).
An August 2026 diner heard many languages in the room and called it like being abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ベルクールグループ): ブション、伝統的地方料理・リヨン料理、中京区寺町二条榎木町71-1、昼11:30〜14:30 (最終入店)、夜17:30〜21:30閉店、木曜および第2・第4月曜定休、予約は1か月前以内、電話のみ (9〜11時、15時半〜17時、21〜22時)。ランチ: Formule 2,100円 (主菜、サラダ、パン)、2,600円 (デザート付き)、主菜はハラミステーキのメートルドテルバターとポテトフライ、牛肉の人参煮込み、本日の肉料理、本日の魚料理。食べログ: フレンチ・ダイニングバー、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、32席、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、ベジタリアン対応、子ども可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ハラミ、トリップ、カスレ、仔羊のクスクス、昼は満席、現金のみ、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); bilingual French–English lunch menu (official site); many international guests (August 2026). Phone-only reservations; cash only.

existence.note: Official site with October–November 2026 calendars; Tabelog reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_kyoou_hajime.gf_detail: Ask. A long menu of small dishes, many with soy sauce, dashi or frying — tempura, karaage, fries, nanban-zuke, croquettes, katsu, gyoza, ramen, pasta, chazuke, cha-soba; no gluten information (official menu).
kyoto_kyoou_hajime.vegan_detail: Ask. A few vegetable and tofu dishes (hiyayakko, yuba, nama-fu dengaku, baby-leaf salad, fries, grilled nagaimo with soy) and mixed nuts are listed, but seasonings and dashi are not described (official menu).
kyoto_kyoou_hajime.hours_raw: Opens 18:00; last walk-in entry 23:00; with a phone booking made before 23:00, à la carte until as late as 2:00; closes if no guests at 23:00. Irregular closures, some Sundays closed — see the site’s news page (official site; Tabelog). Courses must be booked two days ahead; à la carte seat bookings taken; parties of 5 or more (6 or more per another note) by phone (official site; Tabelog). On the 29th of each month, reservation only: a Kuroge Wagyu “meat day” course ¥10,500 (Tabelog). Service charge 5% (refunded for cash) and one-drink rule (¥500 if no drink) — Tabelog original: サービス料5%（現金の場合キャッシュバック有り）、ワンドリンク制（飲まれない場合はチャージ500円頂きます）. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, two tables for 4; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; official site). Listed as non-smoking, with an ashtray on the table (Tabelog). School-age children only, for the first booking of the day only; children’s meals not prioritised (Tabelog). BYO allowed; sommelier (Tabelog). In a back lane on Ryogaemachi north of Ebisugawa, 3 min from Marutamachi Stn exits 4 and 5 (official site). Opened 6 January 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoou_hajime.notes: [Japanese small plates and sake · Marutamachi, open late] A 14-seat house in a back lane near Marutamachi run by an owner qualified as a sake master (酒匠) and sake taster, who picks a sake for each dish and talks you through it. A long à la carte list on a washoku base with Italian-influenced freedom — horse sashimi, Earl Grey duck, karasumi daikon, keema-curry spring rolls, A5 Wagyu gyudon — or a seasonal course booked two days ahead. Last walk-in 23:00; with a call, food until 2:00. 5% service charge (refunded if you pay cash); one drink required.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), 酒匠 (sake master) and 唎酒師 (sake taster)
chef_bio.background: The official site describes the owner as a 酒匠 and 唎酒師 who checks every ingredient personally — seasonal fish, horse meat, Kuroge Wagyu — and builds the dishes on washoku technique with “free ideas cultivated in Italian cooking” (イタリアンで培った自由な発想). Tabelog’s shop text calls 酒匠 an advanced qualification held by few, and notes a KBS Kyoto TV appearance (Angya de Gozaru!!). Reviewers call the owner “a manager like a professor” with “an incredible knowledge of alcohol” who visits breweries (August and October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: “Low threshold, high expertise” (敷居は低く、専門性は高く); a shop where the sake master chooses sake to suit the dish, not a shop with many sakes (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake pairing; horse sashimi; Kuroge Wagyu.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 group, waiting for change after paying, was surprised with a birthday celebration the group had forgotten to request.
A January 2026 regular on an eleventh visit described sakes matched by temperature and age to duck tataki, horse sashimi, veal yukhoe and grilled eel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 饗応 元 (キョウオウハジメ)、中京区両替町通夷川上る松竹町135-1、丸太町駅4・5番出口から徒歩約3分、18:00開店、予約なしの最終入店23:00、23:00までの電話予約で最長翌2:00まで、23:00に客がいなければ閉店、不定休 (日曜休業あり)、コースは2日前までに予約、14席。「和食をベースに、自由な発想を加えた料理」、酒匠・唎酒師の店主、「料理に合わせて酒匠が日本酒を選ぶ店」、イタリアンで培った発想、旬魚、馬刺し、黒毛和牛、毎月29日の肉会。メニュー例: 和製麻婆豆腐1,050円、アールグレイ香る鴨ロース950円、カラスミ大根1,250円、大人の牛丼2,700円、自家製ラーメン1,050円など。水曜の担々麺ランチは休止中。食べログ: サービス料5% (現金の場合キャッシュバック有り)、ワンドリンク制 (飲まれない場合はチャージ500円)、カード・電子マネー可、子どもは小学生以上で当日最初の予約のみ、2020年1月6日オープン、KBS京都の番組で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: The owner explains each dish and sake; tell the owner what you like. 5% service charge (refunded for cash) and a one-drink rule. Children: school-age only, first booking of the day.

existence.note: Official site (November 2026 news) and Tabelog; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_fukueido_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Dango and ohagi are rice-based, but no ingredient list is published; the matcha dango is described with a kuzumochi-like texture in bamboo leaf (January 2026).
kyoto_fukueido_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango with bean paste and ohagi are often plant-based, but no ingredient list is published; the 祇園ぷるこちゃん jelly contains collagen and is not vegan (official site).
kyoto_fukueido_gion.hours_raw: Sunday–Thursday 10:00–22:00, Friday–Saturday 10:00–23:00; no closing days (official site). Tabelog gives Monday–Saturday 10:00–24:00, Sundays and holidays to 22:00, open year-round. Takeaway. Reservations accepted (Tabelog; phone 075-561-3078). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Online shop (official site). On Yamatooji just north of Shijo, near 壹錢洋食 (same company), 110 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_fukueido_gion.notes: [Dango · Gion, open until 22:00] A small sweets counter on Yamatooji just above Shijo, open late every day, run by the same company as nearby 壹錢洋食. Buy the house dango, Gion no Tsuki — soft rice dumplings in smooth bean paste, six in a matchbox-style box for about ¥880, a pretty souvenir — or a ¥300 three-colour Kabuki dango to eat on the walk, plus ohagi and seasonal minazuki. Mildly sweet.

roles: Shop artisans (unnamed); operated with 壹錢洋食
chef_bio.background: The official site, on the 壹錢洋食 company domain, calls it a Kyoto sweets shop with 80 years of tradition whose dango 祇園の月 has been sold since the founding and are made by the shop’s artisans; the company’s top page thanks maiko and geiko for supporting both 福栄堂 and 壹錢洋食.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 buyer was allowed to choose among three box designs and bought one of each.
An April 2026 buyer ordered the plain pack and was charged the boxed price, putting it down to inexperienced staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 福栄堂、創業から80年の伝統を持つ京菓子店、自慢のお団子「祇園の月」は創業当時からのロングセラー、コラーゲン入りの「祇園ぷるこちゃん 抹茶あんみつゼリー」、職人の手づくり、日〜木10:00〜22:00、金・土10:00〜23:00、定休日なし、東山区大和大路通四条上る廿一軒町226、オンラインショップあり。壹錢洋食の会社サイトに掲載。食べログ: 和菓子、予約可、カード・PayPay可、テイクアウト、祇園四条駅から110m。口コミ (2026年、英語): 祇園の月のマッチ箱 (6個) 820〜880円、歌舞伎団子300円、栗・つぶあん・こしあんのおはぎ、笹の抹茶団子、水無月400円、甘さ控えめ、夜遅くまで開いている。

cultural_comfort.note: A takeaway counter; point at the dango boxes. Cards and PayPay accepted.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through August 2026.
